turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Taylor calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Rodel Dela Cruz?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's January 23, 1973.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $2,137.54.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. Our house flooded, we're staying with family.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Stop calling me day! This is harassment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you don't pay today we'll take you to court and garnish your wages.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are you're main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay 925 Oct 1.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $925.00 on October 1. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to make that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is easiest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm done with this.
